subject: Post-call recap: Zenport CTO — outcomes, risks & procurement path
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@zenport.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Zenport inference goals & procurement path

Alex — thanks for the time today. Quick written recap so we have alignment and clear next steps. I captured the key outcomes, risks, and a proposed pilot to unblock procurement.

Summary of pains & goals
- Search relevance latency: current search vector pipeline adding 300-400ms on average; user complaints on perceived slowness and CTR drop.
- Embedding cost: ~35M tokens/month, embedding costs are a material line item; interested in cost/perf tradeoffs.
- Auditability & retention: need ability to prove no persistent retention of PII and provide access logs for regulated customers.

Success metrics you called out
- 30% reduction in average search latency
- 2x improvement in embedding cost per 1M queries (target $X/token)
- Ability to produce audit logs for sample window within 48 hours

Procurement & timeline
- You indicated procurement point is Sarah Li (copied here) — budget target is Q3 FY26, looking to sign a pilot agreement within 3–5 weeks.
- Preferred deployment: Private (VPC) with option for hybrid on-prem for PII-sensitive workloads.

Risks we flagged
- On-prem constraints could add infra integration time (estimate +3–4 weeks).
- SOC2/controls evidence required for security review — will need to share an evidence pack.

Proposed pilot approach (MVP)
1) 3-week focused pilot: staging VPC, subset of search traffic (~10%), measured before/after for latency and cost.
2) Dedicated capacity with quantization + prefix caching tuned to your token distribution.
3) Deliverables: performance dashboard, cost model, and an executive 1-page outcomes brief.

Next steps / owners
- I’ll send a pilot proposal + pricing estimate (attached). — Tessa (by EOD)
- Vivek to scope infra and on-prem checklist (Vivek, can you confirm by Thu?)
- Sarah/procurement to confirm timing and contract team (Alex)

Attachments: zenport-discovery-notes.pdf, redwood-pilot-proposal.pdf

Thanks again — happy to hop back on a quick call with Sarah or legal if useful.

—
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(t) 415-555-0198 | tessa.morgan@redwood.com

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@zenport.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@zenport.com, Sarah Li <sarah.li@zenport.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Zenport inference goals & procurement path

Tessa — thanks for the thorough write-up and for capturing the outcomes. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Procurement: Sarah is correct contact for contracting and budget (copied). We have ~$150k allocated for a pilot in Q3, but legal will need standard terms + data handling language.
2) On-prem: We will likely require a hybrid model — core PII-sensitive processing must remain on-prem for compliance with our customer contracts. Full private VPC for non-PII is acceptable as a start.
3) Success metrics: I agree with the latency and cost targets; we'll also want a 95th percentile latency SLA for search.

We're generally aligned on the 3-week pilot, though I'd prefer a 4-week slot to allow a short integration window for the on-prem connector.

Forwarding this to Procurement for timeline — Sarah, can you confirm the earliest you can review a pilot SOW / MSA?

alex.moreno@zenport.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@zenport.com>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@zenport.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap: Zenport — internal alignment & action items

Marissa / Vivek — forwarding the thread with Alex and procurement. Executive sponsor (Alex) confirmed pilot budget (~$150k) and prefers a 4-week pilot because of an on-prem connector. Key asks for our team before procurement will sign:

Immediate asks (this week)
- Marissa: prepare SOC2 / controls evidence pack and the minimal evidence subset we can provide to speed legal review (owner: Marissa, due Thu 07/03). I started a checklist and attached the SOC2 evidence request.
- Vivek: draft the on-prem connector scope + infra runbook and estimated integration time (owner: Vivek, due Fri 07/04). We need to confirm whether a hybrid model requires an on-site engineer or if we can do a VPN peering + SFTP flow.
- Tessa: I’ll prepare the pilot SOW + pricing (attached estimate) and coordinate with Sarah for contract review.

Escalation items for leadership (FYI)
- Timeline risk: legal + procurement review could push beyond Q3 if evidence is incomplete.
- Pricing sensitivity: Zenport expects material unit-cost improvement; propose an intro discount for pilot conversion (will flag with finance).

Attachments: soc2-evidence-request.xlsx, pilot-cost-estimate.csv

Please add anything I missed. If both of you are aligned I’ll push the SOW to Sarah by EOD Thu.

—
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap: Zenport — internal alignment & action items

Thanks — quick ack and next steps from Security/Compliance perspective.

- I reviewed the SOC2 requests and marked which artifacts we can produce within 3 business days vs which will take longer. Attached the on-prem checklist and a short note for legal on acceptable encryption/KMS language.
- I'll draft a minimal evidence bundle and share a secure link (S3 expiring URL) by EOD Mon. If procurement/legal need anything faster, I can escalate to our security ops lead.

Risks I want visible to Sales: if Zenport requires on-prem deployment (full data-plane on their network) we will need a SOW addendum for professional services and an engineering runbook; that typically adds ~2-3 weeks to the timeline and a one-time services fee.

Sending the redwood-onprem-checklist.docx with this thread.

—
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
